items.title: HFBK Hamburg — PhD in Art Practice (Summer 2027)
items.funding: Semester contribution only (public art academy; confirm current fee page). Separate DAAD possible, not automatic.
items.eligibility: Diplom / Meisterschüler / Master with artistic-practical focus, usually overall grade at least 'good', or equivalent foreign degree with equivalence proof. Special aptitude for artistic research.
items.howToApply: Create applicant account on HFBK HIS-in-One and upload separate PDFs (summary, exposé, degree, CV) in German or English.
items.verifyNote: Official HFBK page: window 1 Sep–14 Oct 2026 16:00 for Summer 2027. Curriculum German and English.

items.title: Studios at MASS MoCA — July–December 2027 residencies
items.funding: Studio + housing. Financial aid / fellowships selectable on the same form; aid typically $0–$450 per week depending on need.
items.eligibility: Visual artists (painting, sculpture, installation, photo, video, fiber, print) and writers. International applicants welcome. All career stages.
items.howToApply: General application on MASS MoCA Studios / Submittable. Open 1 Sep–1 Nov 2026.
items.verifyNote: Official MASS MoCA Studios page: Jul–Dec 2027 call live 1 Sep–1 Nov 2026.

items.title: Kerala PSC — Artist (Information and Public Relations)
items.eligibility: Diploma in Drawing and Painting (MGTE or KGTE) or any equivalent qualification. Age 19–43 (born 02.01.1983–01.01.2007) with usual SC/ST/OBC relaxation.
items.howToApply: Online only via One Time Registration on www.keralapsc.gov.in. No application fee.
items.verifyNote: Official KPSC Extraordinary Gazette Cat. No. 130/2026, last date 07.10.2026. Anticipated vacancies, Direct Recruitment.
